ratchets.name: consistency
ratchets.rule: MC-4b: import no raw Pressable or Touchable* from react-native outside src/shared/ui/primitives and src/shared/ui/navigation. Use a shared/ui primitive (Button, IconButton, Chip, Row) so taps are recorded. If no primitive fits, extend the closest one in src/shared/ui/primitives.
